== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Zev Senesca (Japanese)|Zev Senesca]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/151452834/v-QBWHcezkKdlXqiqtEBNw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 85187817.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>5b3474758146cc11a7f6e33bff7435e55ce9f3308396f25d203324c28448ced7</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
